record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale only history input embeddings by 1+0.01*log(1+c_i)/log(1+c_max), using fixed item counts from training interactions only. This mild frequency-confidence feature may reduce the relative influence of poorly supported context items; the previous rarity scaling regressed. Keep padding zero, candidate embeddings unchanged, and preserve embedding parameterization, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Save scales in each model checkpoint and synchronize predictor loading.

category_rationales.rationale: Apply the supplied mild frequency-confidence feature across all four datasets: scale history inputs by 1+0.01*log1p(training_count)/log1p(max_training_count). Counts use only training interactions. Persist scales as a model buffer, preserve zero padding and candidate embeddings, and synchronize predictor validation. Learned parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
